Adapted from c-testsuite [tests/single-exec/00041.c](https://github.com/c-testsuite/c-testsuite/blob/5c7275656d751de0e68b2d340a95b5681858ed07/tests/single-exec/00041.c). The trial-division prime-counting loops are retained, with the upper bound supplied as an argument and the final count returned instead of compared with 669; a main wrapper calls the counter. The mutation changes the counter's result type from int to void, making the result used by main invalid. The pinned .otags record identifies the original as `git://git.simple-cc.org/scc`, commit `355356a9836e487939cf5e98b5332a63e5264e27`, path `tests/scc/execute/0042-prime.c`. That upstream source was retrieved from the public Git repository and verified byte-for-byte against the pinned c-testsuite file. Its applicable ISC license, including the complete copyright and permission notices from that exact SCC commit, is preserved in [LICENSE.scc](../LICENSE.scc); the c-testsuite top-level MIT license does not apply to individual test cases.
